title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: opening requirements by tier
content:
## Scope

This quick reference covers the six tiers of the Piedmont Crescent Bank Savings & Money Market Accounts product and states, for each tier, the requirements a customer must meet to open an account of that tier: the smallest opening deposit, any checking tier the customer must already hold, the age limits, and the most accounts of that tier one customer may hold.

## Parameter definitions

- **Minimum opening deposit**: the smallest first deposit that funds and activates a new account of the tier, in USD.
- **Required checking tier**: the checking tiers of which the customer must already hold an active account to open the tier; "none" means no checking account is required.
- **Minimum age to open**: the youngest age, in whole years on the opening date, at which the customer may open the tier as sole owner.
- **Maximum age to open**: the oldest age, in whole years on the opening date, at which the customer may open the tier; "no maximum" means there is no upper age limit.
- **Accounts per customer in this tier**: the most open accounts of the tier one customer may hold.

## Tier table

| Tier (rank) | Minimum opening deposit | Required checking tier | Minimum age | Maximum age | Accounts per customer in this tier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Savings (1) | USD 25.00 | none | 18 | no maximum | 2 |
| Statement Savings (2) | USD 100.00 | none | 18 | no maximum | 3 |
| Goal Builder Savings (3) | USD 50.00 | none | 18 | no maximum | 5 |
| Money Market Account (4) | USD 2500.00 | none | 18 | no maximum | 2 |
| Premier Money Market (5) | USD 10000.00 | none | 18 | no maximum | 2 |
| Private Client Money Market (6) | USD 25000.00 | Private Client Checking | 18 | no maximum | 2 |

## Entry gate of each tier, restated as a checklist

Every tier admits a customer only when all of the following hold:

1. the customer's age is at least the tier's minimum age;
2. the opening deposit is at least the tier's minimum opening deposit;
3. the customer's accounts of that tier number fewer than the tier's per-customer limit.

Private Client Money Market adds a fourth item: the customer holds an active account of the required checking tier, Private Client Checking. The other five tiers have no checking-tier item.

## Points of judgement

**Does Goal Builder Savings need a larger opening deposit than Statement Savings?** No. The table reads USD 50.00 for Goal Builder Savings and USD 100.00 for Statement Savings; tier rank does not order the opening deposits.

**A customer already holds two Premier Money Market accounts. Can a third be opened in that tier?** No. Two accounts do not fall below the Premier Money Market limit of 2, so item 3 of the checklist fails for that tier.

**Is there an age above which an account cannot be opened?** No tier sets a maximum age; every tier reads "no maximum".
